title: Supplier grouping in catalog UX; kill form-init/openAdd minted-0 presets; default_rate||0 verbatim policy
summary: Closes the three O-008 remainders. (1) Supplier grouping: the boundary gains inventorySupplierKey (canonical supplier key — trim/lowercase/separator-collapse; blank/non-string/absent -> null) and groupInventoryBySupplier (rows -> [{key,label,rows}] sorted by key, unrecorded supplier pinned last, first-seen authored spelling kept as the display label). normalizeFoundationInventoryRow materializes supplier_key on the calculation copy (absent-supplier rows stay absent; authored supplier_key wins verbatim). Every granted catalog list — FoundationInventory generic tabs + wall/fill grids, WallCapsInventoryTab, MasterSuppliesTab — sections by that key with an explicit group header. (2) Form-init/openAdd laundering: every granted numeric field initializer that minted 0/preset values now opens null — GenericItemForm number defaults, WallMaterialForm cost/dims, WallCapsInventoryTab price/dims, EquipmentInventoryTab openAdd costs/sort, MasterSuppliesTab buildInitial both sides; CL-side draft inputs moved from parseFloat||0 to inventoryNumberInput. (3) normalizeConcreteSupplier's default_rate||0 tail (and the minimum-field ||0 tails) now ride inventoryNonnegativeNumber — explicit 0 stays a real free rate; absent/blank/malformed keeps null instead of minted 0 or verbatim junk. Consume-parity proven: the ported selectedConcrete?.cost_per_unit||0 read resolves null to the same 0 the mint produced.

boundaryContract.inventorySupplierKey: Canonical supplier-group key: string -> trim + lowercase + separator-collapse([\s\-_.]+ -> '_'). Blank/non-string -> null (unassigned group). Never guesses a vendor.
boundaryContract.groupInventoryBySupplier: rows -> [{key,label,rows}] sorted alphabetically by key; key:null (unassigned) sorts LAST. label = first-seen authored spelling. getSupplier override for non-'supplier' fields (vendor_name||service_name, rental_company). Input order preserved inside groups; non-array -> [].
boundaryContract.supplier_key materialization: normalizeFoundationInventoryRow fills supplier_key on the calculation copy ONLY when absent AND inventorySupplierKey(supplier) resolves; authored supplier_key (including null) wins verbatim. Authored rows never mutated.
boundaryContract.explicit-0 adapter: normalizeConcreteSupplier cost_per_unit/minimum_order_yards/below_minimum_cost_per_cy/minimum_cost -> inventoryNonnegativeNumber: authored 0/'0' stays a real zero; absent/blank/malformed/negative/NaN -> null ('not cataloged'). supplier_key = inventorySupplierKey(vendor_name || service_name).
boundaryContract.form-init null draft: Absent stored value -> numeric field opens null (blank input via ?? ""); explicit authored 0 still initializes 0; drafts ride inventoryNumberInput so typed 0 saves as authored zero.

inspectedNoChange: src/components/masterInventory/InventoryFormModal.jsx — already boundary-clean: init falls to '' for numbers (no source.defaults exist), coerce is inventoryNumberInput, default_rate is required for labor services so a concrete supplier cannot persist a missing rate.
src/components/masterInventory/FoundationMaterialDialog.jsx — already boundary-clean: init is {material_type, show_in_foundation} only; inputs render ?? "" + catalogNumberInput.

InventoryTable.jsx (generic Master Inventory renderer incl. Labor & Services list) — outside the granted file set; concrete suppliers land there but the grouping helper + supplier_key now exist for it.
FoundationCatalog.jsx read-only browser — not in grant; its display-only `|| 0` price fallback mints nothing.
MasterEquipmentTab.jsx — edit-form `|| 0` initializers (lines ~73-95, 534-570) and save coercions (~861+) remain: file is outside the granted set; flagged remainder carries forward.

Calc-side consume reads `selectedConcrete?.cost_per_unit || 0`, `activeRebar?.cost_per_unit || 0`, `selectedForming?.cost_per_unit || 0` (legacyFoundationCalc) — resolve absent->0 at the consume boundary identically for null or minted-0 fields; ported math untouched.
sort_order comparator `(a.sort_order || 0)` (EquipmentInventoryTab) — display sort, not a minted stored value; openAdd now passes sort_order:null which the comparator resolves identically.
InventoryFormModal cost-history `Number(h.old_cost || 0)` — audit display of recorded numbers, not a form initializer.
WallMaterialForm subtype/color/texture + applyPreset() — authored non-numeric defaults and an explicit user action; dims/cost now start null so the form-open state stores nothing unauthored.

Channel-letter install cost CONSUMERS (cl_installCalculator parseFloat||0) — non-CMP calculation surface; the MasterSuppliesTab CL draft/initial fields were still converted because they are catalog writes minting stored zeros.
partSync reads raw LaborServiceInventory rows for its own snapshot — entity fields unchanged; the adapter's null semantics never reach it.
behaviorDeltas: Admin add/edit forms open blank for every unpriced numeric field — saving an untouched form can no longer mint $0 prices, 0-inch dims, or 0 costs into the record.
A blanked-out price field now persists null ('not cataloged') where a `|| 0`/`parseFloat||0` path would have minted 0.

A LaborServiceInventory concrete row with no default_rate normalizes to cost_per_unit:null instead of 0 — identical through the ported consume read (null||0 === 0||0); NaN rates now hold null instead of minting 0; truthy malformed strings ('abc') now hold null instead of leaking verbatim into the normalized row.
Catalog lists section by supplier group — same vendor spelled differently lands in one group; unrecorded suppliers render last as 'No supplier recorded' / '— not recorded'.
WallMaterialForm no longer pre-fills standard brick dims/cost on open — applyPreset on an explicit subtype pick still fills standard dims as an authored draft.
